Q3 2026 was a strong quarter for Meridian Analytics. The sales team closed
**14 out of 22 deals**, achieving a win rate of **63.6%** — well above the
company target of 55%. Total new contract value reached **$1,040,000**.

Five deals totalling approximately **$244,300** remain in pending status and
are expected to close before the end of September.

---

## South Region Performance

The **South region** led all territories this quarter with **$468,000** in
closed (won) revenue across four deals:

| D019   | Sofia Delgado   | Meridian Insights Pro  | $198,000  | 2026-09-05 |

quarter. All four South-region wins were Meridian Insights Pro contracts,
underscoring the product's strength in that territory.

---

## Key Metrics at a Glance

| Metric                     | Value        |
|----------------------------|--------------|
| Total Opportunities        | 22           |
| Deals Won                  | 14           |
| Deals Lost                 | 3            |
| Deals Pending              | 5            |

---

## Next Steps

1. Prioritize closing the five pending deals (D007, D013, D018, D020, D022)

2. Begin Q4 pipeline planning — target **$1.2M** in new ARR.
3. Schedule a joint review session to discuss South-region momentum and
   replication strategies for other territories.
